> Plesk is a web hosting and server management platform that helps you manage websites, servers, security, and WordPress from one dashboard\.

Generated by Yoast SEO v28.5, this is an llms.txt file, meant for consumption by LLMs.

## Extensions
- [Image Preview](https://www.plesk.com/extensions/image-preview/): Plugin for file manager, which overlays images on top of the current page\.
- [Server and Site Security Pack](https://www.plesk.com/extensions/offer-server-site-security-pack/): A combination of our most powerful components to secure your server and make your websites globally available\.
- [Developer Pack](https://www.plesk.com/extensions/developer-pack/): Extends Plesk capabilities with essential tools for web developers that run the Web Admin Edition\.
- [Additional Language Pack](https://www.plesk.com/extensions/additional-language-pack/):                 By default Plesk allows you to install one of the many available languages\. Need more? Add them here\.
- [OneAll Social Login](https://www.plesk.com/extensions/social-auth/): Allows to link your account with and log in to social networks like Twitter, Facebook, Paypal, LinkedIn, LiveJournal, OpenID, VKontakte, Google, and Yahoo\!
